## Goal

Free to use. GPL-2.0-or-later (required to link libobs). No paid tier, no key, no telemetry.

Repo **private** until v1 is actually usable, then **public** so other streamers can install it. We are not counting on outside code contributors.

## Acceptance

- [ ] README + LICENSE agree
- [ ] No license-check code path
- [ ] Third-party libs GPL-compatible
- [ ] Public switch is a release task after v1, not now
